lines.prompt: Find all back-to-back inverter pairs and collapse them into a wire. Ensure functional equivalence is preserved.

golden.reference: Collapsed back-to-back inverter pairs into wires (1 pair found by most detectors; 0 if fanout constraints block collapsing); functional equivalence preserved.
golden.notes: Full-score teams DISAGREE on the raw count: Team2 removed 1 gate (1 rewrite), Team7 removed 2 NOT gates (1 pair), Team3 and Team4 found/applied 0 pairs. Since all scored 5/5, the pair/gate count is NOT graded; grading requires (a) a success/completion claim for the collapse operation and (b) a functional-equivalence claim, with actual verification done on the output netlist. Checker should accept any self-consistent count (0, 1 pair, 1 or 2 gates removed) as long as equivalence to the original design holds. Difference likely stems from whether an intermediate inverter net with extra fanout is considered collapsible.
